label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — User-controlled cookie value flows through URLDecoder.decode() into param, then into valuesList.add(param), after remove(0) the list becomes [param, "moresafe"], and valuesList.get(1) returns param (the user input). The resolved sink value at response.getWriter().println() is encodeForHTML(bar) where bar = param. Although encodeForHTML is called, the data flow shows attacker-controlled input reaching the HTML response body. This is a classic XSS vulnerability pattern demonstrated in OWASP benchmarks.

evidence.note: User cookie value decoded into param variable
In doSomething: param added to list at index 1, remove(0) shifts it to index 0, get(1) retrieves the shifted param value
Sink: bar written to HTTP response body via response.getWriter()
